lessons.key: ac_gap::when a value crosses an external cli boundary add a write then reread round trip test per field whose unit could differ scale encoding separator range validation alone cannot catch a unit mismatch
lessons.text: When a value crosses an external-CLI boundary, add a write-then-reread round-trip test per field whose unit could differ (scale, encoding, separator) — range validation alone cannot catch a unit mismatch.

lessons.key: gate_fail::never source test fixtures from an absolute personal path generate them and fail rather than skip when they re missing because a skip keeps the gate green while the path under test silently stops running
lessons.text: Never source test fixtures from an absolute personal path — generate them, and fail rather than skip when they're missing, because a skip keeps the gate green while the path under test silently stops running.
